title: Working on a voxel based survival/colony sim
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: This is after a few days, finally got the voxel world going properly with digging and some voxel resources. Working on the rest of the world gen and resource distribution, and an inventory system now.

comments.author: SweetKarmaz
comments.body:
In case the video didn't get posted with the title, here it is

comments.author: Jolva
comments.body: Looks great! I'm thinking about starting on something similar in a different location. What have you learned so far? Any big surprises?

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: The two largest issues, were getting the different voxel nodes to line up properly and not have seams, and then getting some LOD going.

comments.author: Aggressive-Bus-9430
comments.body: Is this using unreal? Was curious if you are using a voxel plugin or using another engine, thinking about using voxels as well.

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: Before I started working with AI, I was already familiar with Unity - so decided to stick with it. So far, its working out pretty good.
